Chapter 534: Chapter 22: Core Members of the Magic Jade Tower (Please Subscribe)_2

Of course not.

Every Evolver who has cultivated to that level is exceptionally talented. Even if their perception doesn’t match Lin Yuan’s, their broad, overarching view has led them to forge 3,333 Demonic Evolution Paths over such a long time.

But it’s useless.

The requirements for regular members become even higher for higher-level Evolvers.

As for the Supreme Beings, the trials to join the Moyu Tower vanished with the disappearance of the Moyu Tower Master.

In other words, even if Supreme Beings comprehended all the Demonic Evolution Paths within their bodies, they still couldn’t become regular members of the Moyu Tower.

...

“It’s time to leave.”

Lin Yuan rose and left this Virtual World.

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan opened his eyes.

“Now head straight to the Demon Jade Space.”

Lin Yuan sent a thread of consciousness along the Magic Jade Mark toward the Demon Jade Space.

As a core member of the Moyu Tower, he could claim one of the inheritance secret techniques left by the Moyu Tower Master, and the place to claim it was in the Demon Jade Space.

…

Clouds and mists shrouded everything in a hazy veil.

Upon arriving in the Demon Jade Space, Lin Yuan didn’t stop but headed straight for the Nine Floors Dark Tower.

Soon after.

Lin Yuan arrived in front of the Nine Floors Dark Tower.

“You’re here?”

Stone Statue Shen Ji walked out, smiling at Lin Yuan.

“Hmm?”

After looking at Lin Yuan for a while, Stone Statue Shen Ji suddenly changed expression, as if he had seen something unbelievable:

“You’ve become a core member?”

Stone Statue Shen Ji couldn’t believe it.

As the guardian of the Nine Floors Dark Tower, he had the ability to see the rank of every Moyu Tower member, whether they were regular members, core members, or higher.

There were more than ten ways to become a core member of the Moyu Tower.

These methods focused on different aspects, but the undoubtedly hardest was the pure perception test.

To become a core member of the Moyu Tower, an Eighth Layer being must comprehend 33,333 Demonic Evolution Paths.

At just over two thousand years old, Lin Yuan had comprehended the Complete Space Rules, dozens of Cosmic Forces, including one Source-level Cosmic Force.

Such talents, even in the heyday of the Moyu Tower, were unheard of.

Stone Statue Shen Ji never doubted that Lin Yuan could pass the Moyu Tower core membership test purely based on perception.

But this was too fast, wasn’t it?

All these years, Shen Ji had seen Lin Yuan’s progress in the Space Rules, the Fusion Rules, and so on.

How could he have possibly had the time to comprehend so many Demonic Evolution Paths?

Or was it that Lin Yuan’s perception far exceeded his imagination? Did he not need much time to comprehend these Demonic Evolution Paths?

Shen Ji’s heart remained shocked for a long time, unable to settle down.

From the moment Lin Yuan entered the Demon Jade Space, the emotional fluctuations he caused in Shen Ji exceeded those of countless eons combined.

“I was rather lucky,” Lin Yuan smiled.

If this is considered lucky, Shen Ji thought to himself, rather speechlessly, then wouldn’t all those peerless geniuses on the evolutionary paths of the past Moyu Tower just be relying on luck?

“Well, let’s not talk about this anymore.”

Steadying himself, Stone Statue Shen Ji said, “Since you’ve become a core member of the Moyu Tower, by the rules, you’re eligible for a personal summons by the master, and a choice of one of the master’s inheritance secret techniques.”

“But the master vanished in the distant past, so you can’t meet him.”

Stone Statue Shen Ji looked at Lin Yuan with some regret.

He could imagine how happy the Moyu Tower Master would be to see a unique genius like Lin Yuan.

“Thus, you can only receive one of the inheritance secret techniques left by the master.”

Stone Statue Shen Ji said.

“Inheritance secret techniques left by the Demonic Jade Tower Master?”

Lin Yuan’s eyes lit up.

What kind of being was the Moyu Tower Master? Lin Yuan couldn’t be sure, but he must be somewhat stronger than the ordinary Supreme Being.

Such a being’s inheritance secret technique, how could it be ordinary?

Lin Yuan’s aim in reaching the Eighth Layer and becoming a core member of the Moyu Tower was also for these inheritance secret techniques left by the master.

“Here are seven inheritance secret methods, pick one from them.”

Stone Statue Shen Ji waved his right hand.

A screen of light appeared in front of Lin Yuan instantly.

One: Demonic Jade Immortal Body.

The body permanent and eternal like magical jade; once cultivated to perfection, it is indestructible through endless calamities.

Two: Soul Demon Bell.

A defensive secret technique for the soul, able to condense a demon bell on the soul’s surface, absorbing soul attacks to temporarily enhance the soul’s strength.

Three: Great Luo Fighting Skill.

An offensive secret technique…

…

Succession secret methods appeared one after another before Lin Yuan.

It has to be said that the inheritance secret methods left by the Moyu Tower Master were considerately designed, as even Seventh Rank or Eighth Layer beings could attempt to cultivate them.

There were no threshold conditions because, after all, they were only inheritance secret methods, not evolution paths. As long as one was a living being, there was a chance to cultivate them.

Moreover, each secret technique, when cultivated to the ultimate degree of perfection, was frighteningly potent, especially that Demonic Jade Immortal Body, which was described with ‘eternal and everlasting’ and ‘indestructible through all hardships’—just from listening, one knew it was terrifying.

Unfortunately, Lin Yuan already had the Physical Body Divine Ability ‘Blood Rebirth,’ which somewhat overlapped with the effects of this inheritance secret method.

And to cultivate this inheritance secret method to an ‘eternal and everlasting’ and ‘indestructible through all hardships’ level, one would probably have to become a Supreme Being to have a chance.

“The seven inheritance secret methods left by the master all have their strengths—offensive, defensive, life-saving, etc. Choose one,” said the Stone Statue Shen Ji as he looked at Lin Yuan.

“Which one should I choose?” Lin Yuan hesitated.

First of all, defensive secret techniques could be excluded, as he possessed Origin Fine Gold to guard his Physical Soul and Spirit Will, leaving nothing wanting in terms of defense.

Against an Evolver of the same rank, even if Lin Yuan stood still, the opponent would not be able to break his defenses.

Moreover, with the Divine Skill ‘Blood Rebirth,’ even if someone breached his defenses, Lin Yuan could instantly recover.

As for encountering a High-Rank Evolver that he couldn’t resist, having one or two more secret techniques wouldn’t make much of a difference.

Even the most powerful secret techniques depended on the user’s strength.

A baby, even wielding the skill to slay dragons, would truly not be able to kill a true dragon, right?

Furthermore, Lin Yuan, backed by Human Civilization, could also learn and cultivate various inheritance secret techniques, which, although inferior to the seven secret methods left by the Demonic Jade Tower Master, could still be used satisfactorily.

So in the choice of these seven secret methods, it was clear that he should prioritize what he currently lacked the most.

Defensive secret techniques, Lin Yuan didn’t lack.

Life-saving secret techniques, Lin Yuan also didn’t lack.

Offensive secret techniques, Lin Yuan equally didn’t lack.

…

“I choose this secret technique,” Lin Yuan decided after contemplation.

“This inheritance secret technique?” Stone Statue Shen Ji was slightly taken aback.

“Illusory Reality?” The Stone Statue’s expression became a touch peculiar.

“Illusory Reality,” one of the seven inheritance secret methods, was more of an auxiliary secret technique.

It allowed one’s physical body to freely switch between reality and illusion and likewise between illusion and reality.

Here, ‘illusion’ is akin to an energy body or a Soul Body.

This inheritance secret method could change the fundamental structure of life and, in a sense, involved an even higher essence.

But… it didn’t have much significance.

Even if you cultivated this inheritance secret technique and transformed from a flesh-and-blood life form into an energy life form, how much could it really improve your combat power?

Or from an energy life form into a flesh-and-blood life form? There was not much difference.

It was far inferior to choosing an offensive inheritance secret method for self-improvement.

Stone Statue Shen Ji, speculating on which inheritance secret methods Lin Yuan might choose, had never considered “Illusory Reality.”

Because compared with the other six inheritance secret methods, it was somewhat lackluster.

“Are you sure?” Stone Statue Shen Ji unusually took the liberty of speaking up.

He hoped that Lin Yuan would consider thoroughly and not waste this opportunity to select.

The seven secret methods left by the Moyu Tower Master, other than “Illusory Reality,” each was top-notch in their respective fields.

Even if one became a Supreme Being in the future, they would be of great help.

“It is this one,” Lin Yuan said earnestly.

Choosing this inheritance secret method, Lin Yuan had considered carefully.

To other powerful beings, this secret method might not be of much use and was definitely not on the same level as the practical value of the other six inheritance secret methods.

But to Lin Yuan, it was the most suitable inheritance secret method for him.
